articles.title: Bharat Net Worth: Indian Wealth Distribution, Percentiles, and Clean Balance Sheets
articles.summary: An exhaustive reference treatise examining macroeconomic wealth percentiles across India, urban income mobility tiers, the distinction between liquid and illiquid holdings, and the rigorous construction of personal balance sheets devoid of informal family property claims.

articles.title: Rupee Math: Compounding Physics, Real Returns, and Indian Inflation Drag
articles.summary: A rigorous mathematical and economic treatise examining the physics of compounding in India, the severe purchasing power erosion of urban lifestyle inflation, the exact calculus of real post-tax returns, and the destructive effects of sequence-of-returns risk.

articles.title: ZeroDebt India: Debt Avalanche, Recovery Rights, and Credit Repair
articles.summary: An authoritative guide to eliminating personal liabilities in India, dissecting the compounding mathematics of the debt avalanche method, credit bureau repair protocols, and statutory borrower rights under Reserve Bank of India recovery directions.

articles.title: Vault Banking: Bank Solvency Risk, DICGC Deposit Insurance, and Operating Cash Systems
articles.summary: An exhaustive master treatise dissecting institutional banking safety across India, cooperative bank vulnerabilities, the statutory deposit insurance architecture of the DICGC Act of 1961, Section 18A interim resolution payouts, and optimized auto-sweep liquidity management.

articles.title: Card Rewards India: Reward Accounting, Forex Markups, and Milestone Mechanics
articles.summary: An analytical guide to credit card economics in India, examining net reward rate valuation, milestone spend traps, cross-border foreign exchange markup costs, dynamic currency conversion pitfalls, and statutory chargeback protections.
